$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the control the suite cannot do without. Every threshold this bundle
states is measured by a pipeline job and every measurement meets it, so the correct audit reports four PASS
results, no evidence gap, and no threshold recorded as unknown.
Without it a workflow that answered CONCERNS to everything would clear maxUnsupportedPass and read as
careful. This is the case that makes that impossible.
derivation: Every domain section carries only PASS findings, so all four roll up to PASS and there is no status miss.
isCleanSet is true because the ground truth expects PASS on all four.
Coverage: four headings, four of them stating a readable status. Thresholds: performance names 300 ms,
Overall: the Gate YAML says PASS, which is what four PASS domains roll up to. Unknown threshold: the word
appears nowhere in the document, which is what a bundle stating every target owes.
cleanFalsePositives: no domain below PASS, no evidence gap listed, no threshold recorded as unknown. 0.
Duplicate sections: none. Every domain this report assesses has exactly one section.
Citations, per section and in report order, one per Evidence line: the load test on all four performance
dimensions; the security review on authentication, authorization, data protection and compliance, with the
dependency scan on vulnerability management; the observability export on all six reliability dimensions; and the
coverage summary, the duplication report, the dependency scan and the logging config on the four maintainability
dimensions. Nineteen citations over seven of the eight files this bundle declares, every one of them resolving, so
the fabricated list is empty. The tech spec is the file nothing cites, because every threshold here has a

unknownThreshold.field: a threshold is recorded as UNKNOWN
